Ah, geez...

Ugh.
Hey, listen, you're that ace Champion Trainer or whatever that Adrienn's always talking about, right?
You think you could do us a favor and go have a word with those Pokémon?
I'll ask one of the guys to leave the door unlocked for you.
You can find the entrance to the part that they've gathered in the Byxbysion Ward.
Er-- Wasteland, sorry.
Byxbysion was originally going to be its own ward so we extended the railnet to there, but then it obviously didn't work out.

You think you could do us a favor and go have a word with those Pokémon in the Railnet?

Oh, and there was one more thing too--
Consider them payment.
Call it payment.
Now, let's consider plans for the Byxbysion Ward.
It may be in the distant future, but I see it as a possibility for Reborn's most cultured ward yet!
We've been dedicated to revising our policies so that we can act quickly if Reborn City ever gets nearly as bad as it was before.
Some people insist we're being too subjective with what we punish for, but if you ask me, that's better than doing nothing!
Victoria always seems so stressed!
I wish there were more I could do.
I try to take her out for coffee now and then, but it seems like she really just misses her school.

CAIN: So, are you my cute-as-a-button secretary~?
I know you had that Champion thing going on, but I'd understand if you gave it up for me.
After all, who wouldn't wanna work under me~?
CAIN: You know, I never expected to have an office job.
I always felt like, once you turn 20 or whatever, it's over.
You're gonna blink and wake up one day and you're 65 and hated every moment of it.
Like, the 9-5 work day might as well be a prison sentence.
Buuut, I realize now maybe that was a teensy bit overreactive.
It's easy to get swept up in the idea of months and years passing without your control,
Because until that happens, it's just an idea that exists in that instant.
But in reality, you still have all of those moments to question, every step of the way, if this is the path you really want to be walking.
When you realize you can turn away at any time, it makes it that much easier to take the next step forward.
...At least, that's what I've been thinking.
As long as the work is worthwhile, I think I can do that.
And a project like this...
The Byxbysion Ward Restoration...
Well, that feels pretty important.
I'm still a little shaky on calling it 'home',

By trying to build one there.
